dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures on the upper dorsal region exhibit high-contrast, jagged exterior perimeters. A steep gradient transition is visible from the dark charcoal-colored exterior to a light-gray interior core. The largest annulus at the dorsal peak has a roughly elliptical perimeter with non-uniform edge thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters. Visible as small, thin, asymmetrical lines and isolated points lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the transition zone between the head and the mid-torso.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. The angle at the central centroid is approximately 140 degrees, with the anterior-to-middle distance being noticeably shorter than the middle-to-posterior distance.

other_distinctive_markers: A continuous, interlocking web-like network of light-intensity filigree connects several partial 'C' shaped structures across the lower lateral section.
